text.en: Hierarchical Text-Conditional Image Generation is row 85 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Diffusion Model Application area.
text.zh: Hierarchical Text-Conditional Image Generation 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 85 行，所属领域为“扩散模型应用”。

text.en: The annual table associates Hierarchical Text-Conditional Image Generation with “Hierarchical Text-Conditional Image Generation with CLIP Latents”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Hierarchical Text-Conditional Image Generation 与论文《Hierarchical Text-Conditional Image Generation with CLIP Latents》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Aditya Ramesh, Prafulla Dhariwal, Alex Nichol, Casey Chu, Mark Chen”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 阿迪蒂亚·拉梅什、Prafulla Dhariwal（官方页拼写）、Alex Nichol（官方页拼写）、Casey Chu（官方页拼写）、Mark Chen（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Aditya Ramesh, Prafulla Dhariwal, Alex Nichol, Casey Chu, Mark Chen”。
